Policy

How we use AI

Which parts of DappGo are written or translated by language models, which are not, and what we do to keep the output tied to the data.

What AI does not do

  • It does not produce the numbers. Prices, indicators, regime, sector temperature, screens and scores are computed by ordinary code from market data. No language model is involved in calculating or choosing them.
  • It does not write the archive pages on this site. Each daily report page is assembled by a program from one report's data. The sentences are fixed templates filled with that day's figures, and a sentence is left out when its figure is missing.
  • It does not give personal advice. Nothing we publish is tailored to an individual, with or without AI.

Where AI is used

Short commentary in the apps

The apps show a short commentary for each ticker, written by a language model. The model is given that ticker's computed observations and is instructed to describe them conditionally. The commentary is labelled as a reading of supplied observations and not as a forecast or a verified news explanation. Commentary can still be wrong or awkward, which is why the figures it is based on are always shown beside it.

Headline translation

News headlines are translated between English and Traditional Chinese by a language model. Each translation is checked automatically against the original for mismatched numbers, dates and script. A translation that fails is discarded and the original headline is shown.

Drafting guides and policies

The guides and policy pages on this site were drafted with AI assistance under DappGo's direction and describe the rules as implemented in our report code. If a guide and the reports ever disagree, treat it as an error and tell us.

Social posts

Posts on our social accounts are prepared with AI assistance from the same report data and pass automated checks that compare their figures with the report before they are scheduled.

Limits you should know about

Language models can state things that are not in their input. Our controls reduce that risk and do not remove it. When AI-written text and a number on the same screen disagree, the number is what the report computed and the text is the part to doubt. Report it and we will fix the cause.

Your data

The reports are built from market data, not from information about readers. How our sites and apps handle personal data is covered in the privacy policy.
